gloss: sale day; special-offer day; bargain day

definitions.gloss: sale day; special-offer day; bargain day
definitions.explanation: A specific day on which a shop, supermarket, or department store sells selected items at reduced prices. Often held on fixed days of the week or month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{特売日|とくばいび}だ。
{特売日|とくばいび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{店内|てんない}→店内：03124_tennai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{混|こ}んでいる→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: The store is crowded on sale days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦{水曜日|すいようび}→水曜日：00672_suiyoubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特売日|とくばいび}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦{買|か}い→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Every Wednesday is the vegetable sale day, so I go shopping in bulk.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{特売|とくばい}→特売：04277_tokubai⟧ (special sale) + {日|び} (day). Most often refers to weekly or monthly sales at supermarkets, with categories like 'meat day,' 'vegetable day,' or 'tenth-of-the-month sale.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧{特売日|とくばいび}: weekly sale day
- ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特売日|とくばいび}: vegetable sale day
- {特売日|とくばいび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go shopping on sale day

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: sale (general loanword)
- ⟦{特売|とくばい}→特売：04277_tokubai⟧: special sale (the discount itself)
- ⟦バーゲン→バーゲン：08258_baagen⟧⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: bargain sale (often for clothing)
- {大売|おおう}り{出|だ}し: big sale event
